overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the University of Vermont men's soccer team, the Catamounts, on winning the 2024 NCAA Division I national championship. The team beat Marshall University 2 to 1 on December 16, 2024, on a golden goal in overtime, giving the school its first-ever Division I national title. The resolution highlights the team's habit of late comebacks, which earned it the nickname "Cardiac Cats," and asks that copies be sent to the university's interim president, athletic director, and head coach. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on February 4, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution fittingly honors a historic first national title for the university and the state of Vermont.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
